title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the stored-overlay row reads out of protocol.ts into protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts (#25467 cut 16)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 16 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–15 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014 and #26104. The claim is `6417245092`; the scope is the cut 16 proposal of the cut 15 report (`6415780867`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order. All four members moved unedited, so no member was left behind.

Four `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the stored-overlay row reads:

- `readActiveOverlayRows`: a type's active `sys_metadata` rows, through the cross-request overlay cache.
- `storedOverlayEntries`: each row parsed as the list read parses it.
- `namesWithOwnStoredRow`: the names that have a stored row of their own.
- `readItemActiveRows`: one item's active rows.

`protocol.ts` loses 113 net lines (29,440 to 29,327). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread, restarted from `main` `95294be389` after cut 15 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `2b680ef22` and the merge of `main` `601c77384` (`afd0fc791`). That merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `d9c112bc` at both ends.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 36 open PRs, one touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`. #26005 edits `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`, which does not overlap this cut. No open PR edits `protocol.ts` or the new module.

## The order's `new Error(` question

The `new Error(` near these members is at base line `:10741`, inside `resolveAppPackageIdKey`, which does not move. None of the four moved bodies constructs an error (0 `new Error(`, no other error constructor), so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed. The only `catch` in the range (`:10497`) is in `resolveRowlessExpandedView`, which also stays.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `readActiveOverlayRows` | `:10262` | private async | 77 | 330 |
| `storedOverlayEntries` | `:10349` | private | 29 | 166 |
| `namesWithOwnStoredRow` | `:10431` | private | 9 | 98 |
| `readItemActiveRows` | `:10662` | private async | 24 | 235 |

139 body lines (the proposal said about 139).

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–15 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 16]`.
- **Typing.** `StoredOverlayReadHost` types every member as the class member itself (an indexed access on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured by AST walk** (property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped; bare `this` checked too):
  - `readActiveOverlayRows` and `readItemActiveRows` read `engine` (a live getter; the overlay cache keys its bucket on the engine) and `findEnvironmentRows` (a closure).
  - `storedOverlayEntries` reads `convertStoredItem` (a closure).
  - `namesWithOwnStoredRow` reads **no** member. It is a plain function, and its method calls it directly, the way cut 3's `orderByFieldNames` and `groupByFieldNames` stubs do. There is no host and no `.call`.
- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`, in any of the four bodies.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method.** That covers the list and by-name reads in `protocol.ts` (20 `this.` call sites) and `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`, whose own host hands `readActiveOverlayRows` and `storedOverlayEntries` over as closures to the class methods.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

- **Two gain `export` in place, none moves.** `addressPackages` (read by `namesWithOwnStoredRow`; its other reader stays) and the `StoredOverlayEntry` interface (the return type of `storedOverlayEntries`; `RowlessExpandedView` still names it). Neither is re-exported from `index.ts`, so the package's export table and `.d.ts` do not change (below). The new module's import from `./protocol.js` of `addressPackages` is a runtime import; earlier modules already use that cycle (`protocol-publish-batch.ts`, `protocol-drafts.ts`), and it reads only a function declaration, at call time.
- **Imports in `protocol.ts`.** The overlay-cache reads lose their last readers and leave the `./meta-overlay-cache.js` import, which keeps `bumpWriteEpoch`:
  - `metaOverlayCacheTtlMs`
  - `readMetaOverlayCache`
  - `readOverlayCacheGeneration`
  - `writeMetaOverlayCache`
  - the type `MetaOverlayCacheKey`

  The new module imports them from there, and `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` / `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` and the type `StoredOverlayRow` from where `protocol.ts` does; those keep other readers in `protocol.ts`. The one new statement in `protocol.ts` is the import of the new module.

## The durability `--list` (the order's re-measure)

The order expected the members' `engine.find` seams to change file. Measured, they do not. Neither read calls the engine directly: both route through `this.findEnvironmentRows(...)`, which stays in the class and holds the find. `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output, and its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (159 lines; no entry changes file).

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base `95294be389` and head `2b680ef22` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap; `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` clean, and both touched blobs equal to `HEAD`'s after. Measured twice: on the pre-merge tree (base `95294be389`, head `2b680ef22`) and after merging `main` (head `afd0fc791`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119). The readings below hold for both.

- **Raw sha256**: `08914e65f936a2b031c3f3f215481a97f53d132eefd869e4f42d928947ebe173` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 775,874 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. All four members stay `private NAME;` lines. The newly exported `addressPackages` and `StoredOverlayEntry` do not appear.
- **Normalised sha256**: `46ccd7e5c4db673652513d1801ec9c9f06bf34a0a7fb6ba97fb2531ef0cc544b` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; the cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should**: `index.js` hashes `5671669a82bc3837…` at base and `bfb1ef96fc8499bc…` at head. The `.call(host` sites of `readActiveOverlayRows`, `storedOverlayEntries` and `readItemActiveRows` occur 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike); `function namesWithOwnStoredRow(` appears 0 times at base and once at head.
- **Positive control** on the head tree: `private` was dropped from `readActiveOverlayRows` (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `626578dcab46fa8f…` and print `readActiveOverlayRows(request: { type: string; packageId?: string; }): Promise<any[]>;`, so the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. No moved function, the host type, `addressPackages` or `StoredOverlayEntry` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token** (the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, JSDoc skipped, over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body), base `protocol.ts` at `95294be389` against the head module:

```
readActiveOverlayRows: base tokens 330, head tokens 330, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
storedOverlayEntries: base tokens 166, head tokens 166, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
namesWithOwnStoredRow: base tokens 98, head tokens 98, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
readItemActiveRows: base tokens 235, head tokens 235, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=829 differ=0 members=4
CLASS members base=300 head=300 order-same=true byte-identical=296 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=4 other=[]
TOP base=244 head=245 byte-identical=241
```

**Negative control**, one token changed in an in-memory copy of the head module (`overlayCacheTtlMs > 0 ?` to `overlayCacheTtlMs >= 0 ?`, one occurrence):

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts "overlayCacheTtlMs > 0 ? readOverlayCacheGeneration" -> "overlayCacheTtlMs >= 0 ? readOverlayCacheGeneration"
readActiveOverlayRows: base tokens 330, head tokens 330, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
storedOverlayEntries: base tokens 166, head tokens 166, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
namesWithOwnStoredRow: base tokens 98, head tokens 98, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
readItemActiveRows: base tokens 235, head tokens 235, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=829 differ=1 members=4
```

- **Class side.** 300 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 296 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Each of the 4 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** 241 of the 244 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other three:
  - the `./meta-overlay-cache.js` import, losing the five names above;
  - `addressPackages`, gaining `export`;
  - `StoredOverlayEntry`, gaining `export`.

  Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +241 / −136 over 2 files, 377 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 400–480). `protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts` has 218 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path was grepped for the four member names and for the overlay-cache names their bodies use. So was every test file in `packages/` and `ui/`, and `docs/qa/`.

- **By path: none.** No by-path reader names a moved member or reads a moved body's text. `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs` matched only because its self-test carries inline excerpts (a `MetaOverlayCacheKey` struct, an `auditMetaItem` signature); it does not read the moved bodies.
- **Behaviour through the class method, no edit owed:**
  - `protocol.platform-store-system-opt-in.test.ts` calls `protocol.readActiveOverlayRows(...)` at line 265.
  - `protocol.item-active-rows-one-read.test.ts` calls `p.readItemActiveRows(...)` at lines 114 and 123.

  Both pass at both ends (in the package suite). `storedOverlayEntries` and `namesWithOwnStoredRow` are named by no test.
- No hit in `docs/qa/`.
- **ADR anchors and decision letters.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends: 88 anchored files, 59,105 citations, files 8,299 → 8,300, and **1,879 → 1,877** decision-letter citations. The two that leave the anchored file are the `[ADR-0131 D6/D7]` comments in `readActiveOverlayRows`' and `storedOverlayEntries`' bodies (`protocol.ts` `ADR-0131 D6` 113 → 111). The `protocol.ts` anchor entry does not cover ADR-0131, and no entry paragraph describes these reads, so the new module gets no entry (disclosure only, as cuts 8, 12, 13 and 14).
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14087 → 13974, 14112 → 13999). `productionFiles` is 3,725 at base and 3,727 at head: +1 is the new file, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` the spec build writes in the head tree.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`, `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `95294be389`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h`: 0 of 2 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 377 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merge. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` (the whole touched package; it has no `lint` script, these are the root `lint` script's flags) exits 0, no output.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both legs), on the pre-merge tree (the merge changed no file of the package):
  - Base `95294be389`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - Head `2b680ef22`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `95294be389` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- No test outside the package names a moved member, so no cross-package run is owed.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `afd0fc791`, with no stale-tree warning; all 53 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (119/119). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 15. These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, and `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.

The overlay-row family's other members stay for now:

- `overlayLockLayerAt` is named by the by-path kit `protocol.lock-one-resolution.kit.test.ts`.
- `findServedOverlayRow`, `expandStoredViewContainers` and `resolveRowlessExpandedView` were outside this order.
